Il couvre de sable fin des plaques de la: He covered brass plates with fine sand and made them vibrate with a rosined bow: the sand fled what moved and drew the still lines, Chladni figures. He published them in 1787. Napoleon, charmed, paid him to translate his treatise on acoustics into French; it appeared in 1809.
Moine, il enseigne le chant à l'école de: A monk, he taught singing at the cathedral school of Arezzo. He placed notes on lines a third apart, a red one for F, a yellow one for C: the ancestor of our staff. In 1028, the bishop of Arezzo sent him to present to Pope John XIX an antiphonary notated with his method.
On lui attribue les rapports de l'octave: He is credited with the ratios of the octave, the fifth and the fourth. Historians have doubts: he wrote nothing, and his disciples attributed a great deal to him. The legend of the blacksmith's hammers does not hold up; the method would not work. Even the ban on eating beans is disputed: one ancient author claims he liked them.
Il devient en 1565 maître de chapelle de: In 1565 he became chapel master of St. Mark's in Venice, a post he kept until his death. His Istitutioni harmoniche of 1558 made the thirds consonances and put the Ionian mode, our major, first. His former pupil Vincenzo Galilei, Galileo's father, attacked him fiercely; Zarlino replied in 1588.
Chirurgien de l'armée prussienne à ses d: A Prussian army surgeon early on, in 1850 he presented the ophthalmoscope, which lets you see the back of the eye. In 1863, he explained the timbre of instruments by their harmonics, and dissonance by beats. To listen to harmonics one by one, he held tuned resonators against his ear.
Organiste, il publie à 38 ans un Traité: An organist, at 38 he published a Treatise on Harmony that made him famous as a theorist. He only staged his first opera, Hippolyte et Aricie, in 1733, at 50. His harmonies tore Paris apart: Lully's supporters found his music discordant, and the pamphlet war lasted the rest of the decade.
En 1722, il réunit 24 préludes et fugues: In 1722, he gathered 24 preludes and fugues, one in each major and minor key: the Well-Tempered Clavier. The collection shows that a well-tuned keyboard can play everything. What exact tuning did he use? It is still debated: some read a code in the loops drawn at the top of his title page.
Presque sourd dès 1814, il continue de c: Almost deaf from 1814, he kept on composing. On May 7, 1824, in Vienna, he was on stage for the premiere of his Ninth Symphony, but the orchestra followed the actual conductor, Michael Umlauf. At the end, he could not hear the ovation: the singer Caroline Unger turned him toward the audience.
